cli.description: ErrLens — local Python error explanations after command execution.
cli.run_help: Run a program and explain recognized Python errors. Place ErrLens options before COMMAND.
cli.run_pending: Command execution and error analysis are not implemented yet. They are planned for later stages.
cli.postprocess_error: ErrLens | Could not prepare an explanation ({kind}). Original output was preserved.
render.incomplete: Incomplete diagnostic: the exact cause cannot be established.
render.chain.context: The final exception occurred while handling the preceding exception.
render.chain.cause: Python explicitly linked the final exception to its predecessor with raise … from ….
render.other: Other diagnostics: {count}. They are not identified as causes of this error.
render.more: Further linked exceptions: {count}. See the original traceback.
command.install_condition: Only if requests is a required third-party dependency and is missing from this interpreter. Installation may not help for a local module or a different environment. ErrLens does not execute this command.
detail.name: Undefined name: {name}
python.module_not_found.title: Module unavailable
python.module_not_found.description: Python could not find the requested module in the current import environment.
python.module_not_found.cause: The module may be local, belong to another environment, or be absent from the import search path.
python.module_not_found.action: Check the selected Python, active virtual environment, module spelling and local package layout.
python.module_not_found.condition: Install only a confirmed third-party dependency; an import name is not always a distribution name.
python.import_error.title: Import failed
python.import_error.description: Python could not complete an import operation.
python.import_error.cause: Circular imports, an incompatible dependency version or an unavailable exported name.
python.import_error.action: Compare the imported name with the installed version's API and inspect imports between the modules.
python.import_error.condition: The exception alone does not establish that a library is uninstalled.
python.syntax_error.title: Invalid syntax
python.syntax_error.description: Python could not parse the source code.
python.syntax_error.cause: Unclosed brackets or quotes, a missing colon, or syntax from another Python version.
python.syntax_error.action: Inspect the pointer and nearby lines: detection can occur after the actual mistake.
python.syntax_error.condition: Check the code against the Python version that runs the program.
python.indentation_error.title: Invalid indentation
python.indentation_error.description: Indentation does not match Python's block structure.
python.indentation_error.cause: An unexpected indent, a missing block body or an inconsistent nesting level.
python.indentation_error.action: Compare the reported line with adjacent blocks and enable visible whitespace in your editor.
python.indentation_error.condition: Adjust indentation to match the intended nesting, not just the pointer position.
python.tab_error.title: Inconsistent tabs and spaces
python.tab_error.description: Python detected inconsistent use of tabs and spaces in indentation.
python.tab_error.cause: Visually similar indentation can represent different nesting levels.
python.tab_error.action: Show whitespace characters and make indentation consistent throughout the affected block.
python.tab_error.condition: Check the intended nesting before replacing tabs.
python.name_error.title: Undefined name
python.name_error.description: Python could not find a name in the available scope.
python.name_error.cause: A typo, access before a definition, or use outside the defining scope.
python.name_error.action: Check the spelling, definition and scope of the variable or function.
python.name_error.condition: The definition must run before access along the execution path actually taken.
python.type_error.title: Unsupported types or arguments
python.type_error.description: Python could not apply an operation or call a function with the supplied values.
python.type_error.cause: Incompatible operand types, an incorrect argument count or an unsupported operation.
python.type_error.action: Compare the value types and the function signature with the original message.
python.type_error.condition: Convert values only when it matches their meaning; there is no universal conversion fix.
python.attribute_error.title: Attribute unavailable
python.attribute_error.description: The object does not provide the requested attribute or could not return it.
python.attribute_error.cause: A typo, an unexpected object type or a version-specific API difference.
python.attribute_error.action: Check the actual object type, attribute spelling and API documentation.
python.attribute_error.condition: If the value is None, first establish why it was returned; adding a guard may not fix the cause.
python.key_error.title: Key unavailable
python.key_error.description: A requested key is absent from a dictionary-like structure, or its implementation reported that condition with KeyError.
python.key_error.cause: Unexpected input data or a mismatch in the key's value or type.
python.key_error.action: Inspect the structure and key membership; consider get() or an explicit membership check.
python.key_error.condition: A fallback value is appropriate only when a missing key is allowed by the program's logic.
python.file_not_found.title: File or path component not found
python.file_not_found.description: The operating system could not find an object required by a file operation.
python.file_not_found.cause: An incorrect path, a different working directory or a missing parent directory.
python.file_not_found.action: Check the path, current working directory and existence of the required file or directory.
python.file_not_found.condition: Create the object only if the program expects it; a traceback source location is not necessarily the missing path.
python.permission_error.title: Access denied
python.permission_error.description: The operating system refused an operation on a resource.
python.permission_error.cause: Access restrictions, a read-only resource or a lock held by another program.
python.permission_error.action: Check the path, requested operation and current user's permissions; check whether the resource is in use.
python.permission_error.condition: Change access only for the required resource within your authority; administrator privileges are not a universal fix.
python.unknown.title: Recognized exception: {error_type}
python.unknown.description: No verified explanation is available for this type yet. The original message is reported as a fact.
python.unknown.action: Inspect the original message and documentation for the component that raised the exception.
python.unknown.condition: The available data does not establish a specific cause or fix.
python.incomplete.title: Insufficient diagnostic data
python.incomplete.description: An incomplete or damaged Python diagnostic fragment was detected ({error_type}).
python.incomplete.action: Obtain the full traceback; for truncated capture, increase the Capture API limit and retry only if rerunning is appropriate.
python.incomplete.condition: The incomplete fragment does not establish a cause or a corrective command.
python.exception_group.title: Exception group
python.exception_group.description: Python reported a group of exceptions. The analyzer retained only the outer level.
python.exception_group.action: Inspect the nested exceptions in the original traceback and investigate them individually.
python.exception_group.condition: Nested exceptions may have different causes; there is no single fix for the entire group.
